title: Settings — Writing
description: Standalone Writing-settings panel: default post category + default post format over the REST settings surface.

documentation.purpose: DataForm over the REST-exposed slice of WordPress's Writing Settings: `default_category` (select of categories) + `default_post_format` (select of the ten core post formats). Reads + writes through `core-data` `useEntityRecord('root','site')` via the shared `EntityDataForm`. Composable host (`core:settings`) mounts this for the `writing` panel; workspaces mount it directly as a Writing screen.

reads.purpose: Populate the Default Post Category select (per_page 100, ordered by name).

interactions.effect: `await save()`; success snackbar / error notice via `useEntitySave`.

interactions.trigger: Copy a legacy-option CLI command / agent prompt or click the classic link
interactions.effect: No-API fallback affordance for the legacy Writing options — no workspace-side write.

a11y.focus-management: Native DataForm focus order is sufficient.

constraints.note: The legacy Writing options (Post-via-Email `mailserver_*` / `default_email_category`, Update Services `ping_sites`, Link Manager `default_link_category`, `use_balanceTags`) have no REST surface. The panel surfaces them through the shared No-API Fallback (`_shared/fallback/UnavailableViaApi`): classic-screen link to `options-writing.php`, `wp option update` command, agent prompt.
`mailserver_pass` (Post-via-Email password) is deliberately kept out of REST and out of the fallback — a credential is never pre-filled into a copy-paste affordance.

design-system-leakage.purpose: Tiered no-API fallback for the legacy options.
